text: When I was nineteen, I could borrow five grand against my name for college.
I blew that opportunity, joined the military, and now at thirty-two I am back for revenge.
I did not fail because I was stupid.
I did not have the support I needed, and I could not focus on what mattered.
What would a small home I owned have done for my eighteen-year-old self?
I think it would have been revolutionary.
That is the person I keep in mind when I design this.
